# Remy's Lab

> Dog products tested by an actual Lab.

Remy's Lab is a TikTok-connected dog product testing brand built around Remy, a yellow Labrador. The site helps dog owners find current product notes, partner links, discount codes, and written test notes without a hard sell.

## Pages

- [Remy's Lab home](https://remyslab.com/): Current dog product partner links, discount codes, and affiliate disclosure.
- [Lab Notes blog](https://remyslab.com/blog/): Written test notes and honest product write-ups from Remy's real-world testing.

## Lab Notes posts

- [Pack Leashes: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/pack-leashes-test-notes.html): Hands-free bungee leash tested over a full month of trail runs and neighborhood walks.

## Current partner brands

- Pack Leashes: Current partner. Use code REMYSLAB20 for 20% off at packleashes.com.
- Brooks & Roo: Current partner. Code coming soon.

## Brand positioning

Remy's Lab is not a traditional product review blog. It is a TikTok follow-up page for people who saw a product test and want a simple place to find the product, test notes, and discount code.

## Tone

Useful, casual, low pressure, and transparent. Avoid hard-selling language. Product links should feel like helpful notes, not ads.

## Social

- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@remy.lab

## Affiliate disclosure

Some links may be affiliate links. If a visitor uses one, Remy's Lab may earn a commission. That does not change which products are listed or what gets written about them.
